## Review boundary

- [ ] This PR is the Codex-to-reviewer handoff.
- [ ] Implementation correctness and scientific-design quality are assessed separately.
- [ ] Minor review corrections can continue the same session; conceptual redesigns/new hypotheses require a new session.
- [ ] The reviewed SHA will be frozen before expensive scientific runs.
- [ ] CI (`Linux GCC`) is the authoritative full-repository verification check.
